svg.title: Lintel / execution paths and state ownership
svg.desc: Explicit file handoff: a chosen system tool carries the package; the target core can open it in independent state.; Separate apps/site: static information and shared presentation modules, with no call into the execution core.; Shared contracts / operations describe interfaces and fields; state remains with the respective execution owner.

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC, PingFang SC, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lintel / execution paths and state ownership

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC, PingFang SC, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Current source architecture · installation, authentication and release evidence remain separate

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC, PingFang SC, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 01 Environment and file operations: execute on the selected host

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC, PingFang SC, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each executing core owns configuration, preservation, cleanup, restore, host-network plans and specific service operations.

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC, PingFang SC, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 02 Browser: a separately paired local profile

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC, PingFang SC, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The extension owns its operation journal. Final clearing requires a real browser restart and a second approval.

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC, PingFang SC, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 03 Network: routed connections and explicitly requested tests

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC, PingFang SC, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: App and CLI own separate channels. CONNECT does not decrypt TLS; direct outbound traffic is outside this proxy observation.

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC, PingFang SC, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 04 App updating: separate records and release configuration

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC, PingFang SC, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Update intents live in app data, separate from core jobs. The dashed release connection is not configured or active.

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC, PingFang SC, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Explicit file handoff: a chosen system tool carries the package; the target core can open it in independent state.

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC, PingFang SC, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Separate apps/site: static information and shared presentation modules, with no call into the execution core.

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC, PingFang SC, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Shared contracts / operations describe interfaces and fields; state remains with the respective execution owner.

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC, PingFang SC, Arial, sans-serif
